Risk-flag threshold for reporting delay exposure, not a clinical claim. Observational evidence. VA cohort (Gastroenterology 2021, https://doi.org/10.1053/j.gastro.2021.01.219) shows CRC HR 1.13-1.28 from 13 months. Timeliness benchmarks: PROSPR 90 d (secondary citation), UAE 31 working days (below).
parameters.source: Systematic review, Clin Gastroenterol Hepatol 2021 (PMID 33010414): colonoscopy 'should not be delayed beyond 9 months' after positive FIT. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cgh.2020.09.048 . Corley JAMA 2017: first significant excess at 10-12 months, any CRC OR 1.48 (1.05-2.08), advanced stage OR 1.97 (1.14-3.42); >12 months OR 2.25 and 3.22. https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jama/fullarticle/2620087
